title: Motie van het lid Beckerman over een bevoegde instantie aanwijzen om ook deepfakeporno en andere onrechtmatige seksuele beelden offline te halen

reading.body:
Generative AI tools were used to create synthetic pornographic videos by placing the faces of Dutch public figures onto pornographic content without consent. The videos were distributed on a platform with millions of monthly users, reaching an audience at scale. This is an impersonation attack enabled by image synthesis technology, not a malfunction of a system used for its intended purpose.

The deployment failure was the absence of content moderation at the distribution point. An online platform with 13 million monthly visitors did not detect or remove the synthetic sexual imagery before it circulated widely enough to harm the victims. Catching this would have required either automated detection of manipulated sexual content, human review of flagged material, or both, deployed before videos reached users.

It is not established who created the deepfakes, what specific tools they used, or how long the videos remained online before removal began.

summary:
Multiple female Dutch celebrities are considering filing complaints after discovering themselves in manipulated pornographic videos posted on an online platform with 13 million monthly visitors. The videos feature the faces of Dutch entertainers, television presenters, Olympic athletes, government ministers, mayors, and royal family members placed onto pornographic actresses. The interim Justice Minister called the videos disgusting and urged victims to report them. Several victims have already filed complaints or are exploring legal options.

Deepfake pornography is classified as revenge porn and is illegal. Legal experts advise victims to file reports, which may allow prosecutors to shut down websites hosting such material. Additional options include starting class action lawsuits, filing complaints with the Data Protection Authority, or contacting hosting companies. Previously, presenter Welmoed Sijtsma became a victim of such deepfakes and created a documentary series about her experience. A 39-year-old man from Amersfoort received a conditional sentence of 180 hours in November for creating fake videos of her.
title_en: Motion by member Beckerman on designating a competent authority to also remove deepfake pornography and other unlawful sexual images offline
